_info: Ajustes globales del sitio: contacto, redes, empresa, SEO de las páginas fijas y taxonomías (conceptos, destinos, duraciones). En WordPress: Sunqu › Sitio.

inicio.title: Sunqu Journeys — Tailor-made trips to the heart of Peru
inicio.description: Peruvian agency for tailor-made trips. Live the history, the food and the people of Peru with local hosts and a Travel Advisor by your side before, during and after.

descubre.title: Discover journeys and experiences in Peru — Sunqu Journeys
descubre.description: Journeys of 9 to 14 days and one-day experiences in Peru. Filter by what interests you, the destination or the days you have.

recuerda.title: Remember · Reviews and shop — Sunqu Journeys
recuerda.description: Reviews, photos and videos from travelers, and the Sunqu shop to wear Peru with you.

diario.title: Sunqu Journal: guides and stories for traveling to Peru
diario.description: Guides to prepare your trip, Peruvian food and the communities that welcome you, told by the Sunqu team.

terminos.title: Terms and conditions — Sunqu Journeys
terminos.description: These terms explain how you book with Sunqu, how you pay, what happens if you need to postpone or cancel, and how we look after your data.

reclamaciones.title: Complaints book — Sunqu Journeys
reclamaciones.description: If something didn't go as we promised, we want to know. Virtual complaint form under Peruvian Law No. 29571.
